title: US2 media, contributor and p5 implementation is verified; protected closure remains
summary: PR #67 remains draft-only. The selected media_variant.public_storage_key resolver, revision-scoped contributor/byline source and public contract, and actual p5@2.3.0 instance-mode runtime are implemented and verified at the implementation head. CI, Security and 9/9 browser tests pass. Protected merge, production migration/activation and task checkbox state remain human gates.

claims.text: PR #67 is a draft branch from main@c45c1fd7e93699f4626e2ceab6b5fb6f52f38842 and does not merge or change task checkboxes.
Public media projection selects the exact requested media_variant.public_storage_key only after READY, VALID, PUBLIC_WEB and validity-window checks; unsafe or missing keys fail closed.
The public byline source is contributor plus revision-scoped article_contributor, projected as ArticleProjection.contributors[] with role and position semantics.
The web dependency is p5@2.3.0 with a frozen pnpm lock; CourtPulseRuntime uses client-only instance mode, deterministic seed/first frame, noLoop/loop visibility policy and remove on unmount.
Implementation head eb7fc608bca82183889237c46b0f123a8555037c passed CI run 31314690495, Security run 31314690491 and browser job 93248022363 with 9/9 tests passing.
Protected merge, production migration execution/public activation and task checkbox changes were intentionally not performed.
